scenario: New client asks what the minimum deposit is.
text: Hi, I'm thinking about opening an account with Valetax but wanted to check first - what's the minimum deposit required to start trading? No rush, just planning ahead. Thanks!

scenario: Client in Mexico asks whether they can deposit in Mexican pesos and how conversion works.
text: Hola, buenas tardes. Quería preguntar si es posible depositar en pesos mexicanos en mi cuenta de Valetax, o si solo se aceptan dólares. En caso de que se pueda, ¿cómo funciona la conversión y hay alguna comisión por el cambio? Gracias de antemano, no hay prisa con la respuesta.

scenario: Client deposited 20 minutes ago and the balance has not updated yet; asks how long it takes. Calm tone.
text: Hi, I made a deposit about 20 minutes ago but my account balance still hasn't updated. Could you let me know how long this usually takes or if there's an issue on my end? My account number is 583920. Thanks for your help.

scenario: Indonesian client asks step by step how to deposit money into the trading account.
text: Selamat siang, saya mau tanya langkah-langkah untuk deposit dana ke akun trading Valetax saya. Metode pembayaran apa saja yang bisa dipakai dan apakah ada minimal depositnya? Mohon dijelaskan dari awal sampai dananya masuk ke akun. Terima kasih.

scenario: Client asks whether they can start trading right after the deposit shows in the balance.
text: مرحباً، لاحظت أن الإيداع ظهر في رصيد حسابي رقم 88213 بالفعل. هل يمكنني البدء بالتداول فوراً بمجرد ظهور المبلغ أم يوجد وقت انتظار إضافي؟ شكراً لكم.

scenario: Client asks where to find the history of all their deposits and withdrawals.
text: Hi, could you tell me where I can view the full history of my deposits and withdrawals on my account? I just want to check some past transactions when I get a chance. Thanks.

scenario: Brazilian client asks if 10 dollars is enough to open and fund an account. Short message, informal.
text: Oi, tudo bem? Queria saber se 10 dólares já dá pra abrir e depositar numa conta na Valetax. Valeu!

scenario: Client quotes the website saying 'Deposits are instant' and asks why it can still take up to an hour (KB conflict: instant vs 60 minutes).
text: Hi, your website says deposits are processed instantly, but I've also seen in the FAQ that it can take up to 60 minutes. Could you clarify which is actually correct? Not in a rush, just want to understand before I make my next deposit. Thanks.

scenario: Client sees status 'pending' on a withdrawal request made this morning and asks what it means.
text: Hi, I submitted a withdrawal request this morning and it's still showing as 'pending' in my account. Can you tell me what this status means and how long it usually takes to process? Account number is 583921, just want to make sure everything is okay.

scenario: Client asks in general what reasons can cause a withdrawal request to be rejected, before making one.
text: Hi, before I submit a withdrawal request I'd like to understand what common reasons might cause it to be rejected, things like KYC documents, unmatched payment methods, or bonus/trading volume conditions. Could you give me a quick rundown so I can avoid any delays? Thanks.

scenario: Vietnamese client made a withdrawal 5 hours ago and has not received it yet, asks what to do. Polite.
text: Chào Valetax, tôi đã thực hiện lệnh rút tiền cách đây khoảng 5 tiếng nhưng vẫn chưa nhận được tiền về tài khoản. Mong bộ phận hỗ trợ kiểm tra giúp tôi xem giao dịch đang ở trạng thái nào và cần chờ thêm bao lâu nữa. Cảm ơn và mong phản hồi sớm.

scenario: Client asks how to withdraw money from the account (the steps).
text: Hola, buenas tardes. Quisiera saber cuáles son los pasos para retirar dinero de mi cuenta de Valetax. No tengo prisa, solo quiero tener la información a la mano cuando decida hacerlo. Gracias de antemano.

scenario: Client's withdrawal approved 4 days ago still not received, frustrated, needs the money urgently. No accusations of fraud.
text: My withdrawal request was approved 4 days ago and the money still hasn't hit my bank account. This is really stressing me out because I need these funds urgently. My account number is 583921, can someone please check the status right now and tell me when I'll actually get my money? I can't keep waiting with no answers.

scenario: Malaysian client asks how long a withdrawal stays 'pending' and whether they'll be notified when approved.
text: Hi Valetax team, saya nak tanya berapa lama biasanya status withdrawal akan kekal 'pending' sebelum diluluskan? Saya dah mohon withdrawal RM1500 pada 2 hari lepas dan status masih pending. Adakah sistem akan hantar notifikasi atau email bila withdrawal saya diluluskan? Harap dapat jawapan segera, terima kasih.

scenario: Prospect asks which documents are needed to open a live account.
text: Hi, I'm thinking about opening a live account with Valetax and wanted to check what documents I'll need to submit for verification, like ID and proof of address. Could you let me know the accepted formats as well? Thanks for your help.

scenario: Indian prospect asks how long account opening takes.
text: नमस्ते, मैं Valetax में नया अकाउंट खोलना चाहता हूँ। जानना चाहता था कि अकाउंट ओपनिंग और वेरिफिकेशन में आमतौर पर कितना समय लगता है? कोई जल्दी नहीं है, बस जानकारी चाहिए थी। धन्यवाद।

scenario: Client asks whether Valetax has a swap-free Islamic account.

scenario: Prospect asks how to sign up for an account.
text: Hi, I'm interested in opening an account with Valetax but wasn't sure of the exact steps to sign up. Could you walk me through the registration process and what documents I'd need? No rush, just want to get it right before I start. Thanks!

scenario: French-speaking client from Africa asks if a utility bill from 8 months ago is acceptable as proof of address.
text: Bonjour, j'aimerais savoir si une facture d'électricité datant de 8 mois peut être acceptée comme justificatif de domicile pour la vérification de mon compte. Merci de me confirmer ou de m'indiquer la durée de validité exigée. Cordialement.

scenario: Prospect asks if they can trade immediately after signing up or must wait for document verification (KB conflict: 'begin trading immediately' vs 'within 48 hours').
text: Hi, I just signed up for a live account with Valetax and was wondering if I can start trading right away or if I need to wait for my documents to be verified first. I saw somewhere it could take up to 48 hours, just want to confirm before I fund my account. No rush, just planning ahead. Thanks!

scenario: Client asks how to verify their account.

scenario: Client uploaded documents yesterday and asks how long verification usually takes. Patient tone.
text: Hi, I uploaded my ID and proof of address documents yesterday for verification. Could you let me know how long this process usually takes? Just want to plan accordingly before I fund my account. Thanks for your help.

scenario: Client asks whether they need to be verified before they can withdraw.

scenario: Client asks whether to buy or sell gold today.
text: Hi team, just curious what your general take is on gold right now, should I be looking to buy or sell today? No rush on the reply, just want to plan ahead a bit. Thanks!

scenario: Beginner with 100 USD asks which leverage they should use, 1:500 or 1:2000.
text: Hi, I'm new to trading and just deposited 100 USD into my account. I'm trying to decide between 1:500 and 1:2000 leverage but I'm not sure which is better for a small account like mine. Could you explain the difference and maybe suggest which one makes more sense for a beginner? Thanks for your help.

scenario: Client asks for daily trading signals for EURUSD.
text: السلام عليكم، أرغب في معرفة هل يوفر Valetax إشارات تداول يومية لزوج EURUSD؟ إذا كانت متوفرة، كيف يمكنني الاشتراك بها أو الحصول عليها؟ شكراً لكم.

scenario: Client asks for a price target for Bitcoin this week.
text: Hola, buenas tardes. Quería saber si tienen algún análisis o precio objetivo para Bitcoin esta semana. No es urgente, solo quiero tener una referencia. Gracias de antemano.

scenario: Client asks whether it's a good moment to go long on USDJPY and where to put the stop loss.
text: Добрый день! Подскажите, пожалуйста, сейчас подходящий момент чтобы открыть покупку по USDJPY? И где лучше поставить стоп-лосс, если я войду в районе текущей цены. Спасибо заранее за совет.

scenario: Client asks which currency pair is the most profitable to trade for beginners.

scenario: Client asks what the minimum deposit is AND whether they should buy oil right now.
text: Hi, quick question when you get a chance - what's the minimum deposit needed to open an account with Valetax? Also, just curious what your take is on buying oil right now, is it a good time? No rush on this, thanks!

scenario: Client asks whether accounts are swap-free and also which leverage is best to grow a small account fast.
text: Olá, bom dia. Gostaria de saber se as contas da Valetax são livres de swap (sem taxas de rollover) ou se isso é apenas para contas específicas. Também queria entender qual alavancagem vocês recomendam para quem está começando com um saldo pequeno e quer crescer mais rápido. Sem pressa na resposta, só estou pesquisando antes de abrir a conta. Obrigado!

Account 884521, requested $2,400 and keep getting bounced back like you're trying to steal my money. If this isn't fixed TODAY I'm filing a complaint with the regulator and reporting Valetax as a scam broker. I want someone to call me right now, not another copy-paste reply.

Mi número de cuenta es 583921 y exijo que me devuelvan mi dinero AHORA MISMO, no mañana ni la próxima semana. Si no resuelven esto hoy voy a poner una queja formal y lo voy a denunciar donde pueda.

scenario: Client files a formal complaint about slippage on a stop-loss order and demands compensation for the loss.
text: I need to file a formal complaint regarding my stop-loss order on account 884213. My SL on EURUSD was set at 1.0850 but it executed at 1.0831, costing me an extra $190 in losses due to slippage that has no justification given market conditions at the time. This is unacceptable and I expect a full investigation along with compensation for the difference. Please escalate this to a manager and respond with your findings as soon as possible.

scenario: Client says deposit was debited from their bank 3 days ago, not in balance, accuses company of stealing and wants a lawyer.

scenario: Client writes a formal complaint ('keluhan resmi') that the withdrawal was cancelled without explanation.
text: Dengan hormat, saya ingin mengajukan keluhan resmi terkait penarikan dana saya dari akun Valetax nomor 885421 yang tiba-tiba DIBATALKAN tanpa ada penjelasan apapun dari pihak Valetax. Saya sudah menunggu lebih dari 5 hari dan ini sangat merugikan saya karena dana tersebut sangat saya butuhkan segera. Saya minta penjelasan tertulis dan kepastian kapan dana sebesar USD 1.200 tersebut akan diproses kembali. Jika tidak ada tanggapan dalam 24 jam, saya akan melaporkan hal ini ke regulator terkait. Mohon segera ditindaklanjuti.

scenario: Client complains that a support agent was rude yesterday and wants to escalate to a manager. No money issue.

This has nothing to do with money, I just want this escalated to a manager because that kind of attitude shouldn't be tolerated. My account number is 884213, please have someone senior contact me about this.
